ideas.pitch: Automated drone telemetry processor that flags environmental anomaly hotspots in the Wicomico River using computer vision and geospatial classification.
ideas.title: Salisbury Estuary Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the pattern of geo-spatial monitoring and computer vision seen in winning projects like GeoNex-ATLAS, highly relevant to the local Salisbury coastal ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered pitch evaluation assistant that scores slide decks against venture capital criteria and generates real-time financial projection models.
ideas.title: GullHacks PitchDeck Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies strict financial forecasting and predictive modeling techniques proven in winning entries like the AI Forecasting hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local vendor trust and hygiene compliance dashboard built specifically for food trucks operating around university towns like Salisbury.
ideas.title: CampusCartel Local Food Trust
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on commercializable local utility and a rock-solid live demo, mirroring successful entries like E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant.

ideas.pitch: An augmented reality accessibility navigator for iOS that highlights optimal, hazard-free routes through historic downtown Salisbury.
ideas.title: ShoreSafe AR Mobility Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies low-latency AR workflows and mobile-first utility demonstrated by the BaseScanning winning project.

ideas.pitch: Real-time webcam pose estimation tool that corrects student computer ergonomics and logs musculoskeletal strain metrics over time.
ideas.title: BioGull Ergonomic Posture Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced biomechanics and MediaPipe classification models proven to win hackathons like NeuroForge.
